title: A Rock Hit Mars and Threw Ice Boulders 23 Miles Away

scenes.text: A space rock hit Mars and threw chunks of ice 23 miles.
It struck on December 24th, 2021. A NASA lander felt it as a magnitude 4 marsquake.
The rock was only 16 to 39 feet wide.
But the crater is 492 feet wide and 70 feet deep.
Mars has thin air, so the rock never burned up before it hit.
It dug out boulders of buried ice, closer to the equator than ever found.

description:
A meteoroid hit Mars on December 24th, 2021 and flung chunks of ice up to 23 miles.
NASA's InSight lander felt it as a magnitude 4 marsquake, and an orbiter later spotted the 492 foot crater.
Would you want to live on Mars?
